clue.text: Flight looks hard, they say

indicators.note: the phrase signals that we want a word spoken like the clue's words, not spelt like them

parts.note: to look hard at something is to stare at it

explanation.surface: Someone eyeing a long run of steps and finding it daunting.
explanation.definitionFit: A flight is a continuous series of steps between floors, the same thing as a staircase.

clue.text: Blue team captures northern queen

indicators.note: one piece takes another prisoner, so it holds it inside

parts.note: a squad is a sports team

explanation.surface: A sports report: the Blues take a northern queen, perhaps in chess.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Blue' is a verb here: to blue money is British slang for spending it recklessly.
explanation.definitionFit: Blue, as a verb in British slang, means to waste or fritter money away.

clue.text: Stupidly distilled Islay around 9

explanation.walkthrough: 'distilled' rearranges the island's letters to ASILY, and 'around' puts them either side of the number. Unlike most clues here, 9 means the number itself, not the answer to 9 down.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something in a foolish, senseless manner is behaving in an idiotic way.

clue.text: 9 about to be big-hearted

parts.note: RE means about or concerning

explanation.definitionFit: A pinkish-red shade is a hue named after the flower, so it is an example of a colour.

clue.text: In favour of church agent being made to eat

clue.text: I've finished talking up service that's too remote

clue.text: Bend 9 round high-class cookery

parts.note: the clue points to the answer at 9 down

explanation.definitionFit: The French phrase, literally 'blue ribbon', describes cooking of the highest standard.

clue.text: "Bone" is "bird" in French

parts.note: the emu is a large flightless Australian bird

clue.text: Old terrorist leader penetrates the German Right

indicators.note: the pieces push their way inside another

parts.note: der is a German word for the

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter

clue.text: Pass over, in the end, to you for characteristic ambience

clue.text: Top-class legs on donkey suddenly disappeared

pins is slang for legs

clue.text: Different version in answer to Mark 9

explanation.surface: An alternative reading given in reply to a verse of Mark's gospel, chapter nine.

clue.text: 9 in French film genre

a style of dark crime cinema

explanation.surface: A colour and a style of film.
explanation.definitionFit: The French word for black also names moody, cynical crime films of the 1940s.

clue.text: Whip back dish which is full of greens

explanation.surface: A kitchen instruction: whisk again a dish packed with vegetables.

clue.text: 9 deeply confused about Oscar being given a new job

explanation.walkthrough: 'confused' gives EPLYED from DEEPLY; 'about' wraps it round O to give EPLOYED.

clue.text: Possibly shades English tree, getting attention

parts.note: the yew is an evergreen tree

clue.text: Strong died in brown

parts.note: rust is a reddish-brown colour

clue.text: Yellow fish with fight in them likely to be cleared out

a war is a fight

clue.text: Goddess of mercy, be lenient!

indicators.note: the answer is made of some of the letters of the following words

clue.text: Black mark on counter once this person goes out

clue.text: Farewell performance ends in heroic failure

clue.text: Uneasy lumberjack's shelter

explanation.surface: A nervous logger's hut.
explanation.definitionFit: Asylum is protection or a place of refuge.

clue.text: Nag crew for fixed navigation aids on the radio

clue.text: Catastrophic legal line abandoned

parts.note: lawful means legal

clue.text: Exploding, mostly after cheese

clue.text: Unpleasant substance found on hard drive

explanation.surface: Something nasty discovered on a computer's hard disk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hard drive' looks like one computer term; the definition is 'drive' alone.
